user.title: Connect your Whirlpool appliance account
user.description: Enter the account used by the Maytag app. Appliance IDs may be separated by commas or entered one per line.

reconfigure.title: Update Whirlpool appliance settings
reconfigure.description: Update the account or appliance IDs. Leave the password blank to keep the currently saved password. Appliance IDs may be separated by commas or entered one per line.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Whirlpool appliance account
reauth_confirm.description: The Whirlpool cloud rejected the saved credentials. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Whirlpool cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The email or password is incorrect.
error.invalid_appliance: At least one appliance ID is required, or an appliance ID could not be found.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The account email cannot be changed. Remove and add the integration again to use another account.
